newsitem.title: GERMANY: American to drop Frankfurt-Miami flight Jun.
newsitem.headline: American to drop Frankfurt-Miami flight Jun.

text.p: American Airlines said it will drop its daily flight between Frankfurt and Miami from June 1.
The U.S. carrier said the two-year-old service made a loss which could no longer be carried.

"We did not take this decision lightly. Unfortunately the route produced constant losses and we have to concentrate our operations on more profitable services," said Hans Mirka, American Airlines senior vice president in a statement.
American currently flies between Frankfurt and Miami with a Boeing 767-300.
A Frankfurt-based spokeswoman added: "This has been under consideration for a long time. The load factor in economy was good but first and business class were not satisfactory."
The forthcoming alliance with British Airways had not been a factor in the decision to drop the Miami service, she added.
American would still fly 767-300 daily services from Frankfurt to Chicago and to Dallas/Fort Worth, the spokeswoman stressed.
